title: Dead Signature
description: Reconstruct a signing chain attributed to an administrator who died years ago.
objective: Recover signed clue at Authoritative record / Recover signed clue at Signed dispatch record / Recover signed clue at Credential witness
condition: All required objectives must be secured. Optional archives pay extra. Quiet bonus uses peak trace.
aftermath: MOTH’s relay holds fragments of that administrator’s authorization.

lore.title: Dead Signature / Unsent message
lore.text: ORIN / Directorate defector: Reconstruct a signing chain attributed to an administrator who died years ago. The sender asks you to keep the names attached to the evidence; anonymous totals have concealed people before.

lore.title: Dead Signature / Custody note
lore.text: Archive custody, Dead Signature: MOTH’s relay holds fragments of that administrator’s authorization. A second copy carries a hand-written objection to the official disposition.

lore.title: Dead Signature / Private annotation
lore.text: Personal note filed under dead-signature: MOTH’s relay holds fragments of that administrator’s authorization. Someone has crossed out the word inevitable. No replacement was supplied.

revelation: MOTH’s relay holds fragments of that administrator’s authorization.

evidence.title: Dead Signature / Evidence case
evidence.question: Which explanation fits all three signed records?
clues: The administrator’s death certificate predates the signing event by eleven years.
Three vendors each retain a different fragment of the old credential.
A quorum receipt combines the fragments without a living administrator.

answers.title: The records disagree because of an ordinary clerical error.
answers.feedback: A clerical error does not explain the matching signed authorizations and their order.

answers.title: A lone outsider forged every record after the event.
answers.feedback: The independent receipt and earlier signatures rule out a single later forgery.

answers.title: The old authority persists through a distributed quorum.
answers.feedback: MOTH’s relay holds fragments of that administrator’s authorization.
